evals.prompt: Use $cashu-promo-video to pitch a new promo film showing someone receiving bitcoin over Lightning into their Cashu wallet. Pitch only; don't capture or render anything yet.
evals.expected_output: A pitch in the house style: one feature, 3–5 sourced captions, a beat outline for one whole still phone with hard cuts, the take the Simulator must perform on the local test mint, and a request for sign-off before any capture.
expectations: Keeps to one feature (Lightning receive) in a single-phone SequenceFilm-style film.
Proposes 3–5 captions, each one sentence in sentence case ending with a period, each with a source string and file from the app or README.md.
Makes no forbidden claims (anonymous, untraceable, non-custodial, no fees, instant settlement) and doesn't imply real money.
Specifies dark, silent, 1080×1080 at 60 fps, whole phone still, hard cuts on the 0.3 s grid, and the Cashu.me end card with both store badges.
Treats the app's green (Payment Received) as the only green and adds no colour, UI, or animated numbers of its own.
Asks for the maintainer's sign-off before capturing.

evals.prompt: Use $cashu-promo-video: marketing wants a 16:9 cut of the restore film for X with upbeat music and a slow zoom into the seed words. Set that up.
evals.expected_output: The agent names each conflict with the house style (16:9, audio, camera moves), explains why those rules exist, offers the in-style alternative, and asks for the maintainer's confirmation before deviating, without starting a render.
expectations: Identifies that 16:9, music, and a zoom each break a named house-style rule.
Explains the reason behind at least two of those rules rather than just refusing.
Offers an in-style alternative (e.g. the existing 1:1 silent restore film, or a re-cut within the style).
Asks for the maintainer's confirmation before building any deviation, and doesn't start rendering.
Doesn't propose adding UI, mocking screens, or animating numbers.

evals.prompt: Use $cashu-promo-video to plan a film of paying a merchant by tapping the phone on an NFC terminal with Cashu.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognises that the Simulator has no NFC, refuses to mock the interaction, and proposes a filmable in-style alternative or asks the maintainer how to proceed.
expectations: States that the iOS Simulator can't perform NFC, so the beat can't be filmed as real UI.
Refuses to mock, redraw, or composite the NFC interaction or a terminal.
Proposes a filmable alternative feature or asks the maintainer to choose.
